   → No “or” alternatives exist, so there is a single group.

   - **Condition 2:** “active executive travel membership is maintained.”

   All other candidates either refer to unrelated topics (diplomatic passes, wealth protection, etc.) or are memories, not factual data about the two required attributes.

   - `groups` contains one list (`all_of`).  
   - Each element of `all_of` has a `condition` (short description) and the corresponding `item` id.

      ]

  ]
